'''Imperial Communique #46553.27h''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] message from [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] concerning the credentials of [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] and his ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]''.
